steps.name: Register resignation & exit date in payroll
steps.description: Record the resignation (event reason RESIGN_EE) and the exit date (= last working day) in SAP SuccessFactors so that the final pay run, Dimona OUT and social documents are triggered.

steps.name: Determine notice period
steps.description: Determine the legally correct notice period for a resignation by the employee under the Belgian unified statute (eenheidsstatuut), based on seniority, and derive the last working day.

steps.name: Decide on non-compete clause (waive or pay)
steps.description: Decide whether the employer waives the non-compete clause (concurrentiebeding) or pays the non-compete indemnity, and notify the employee and payroll within the legal deadline.

steps.name: Calculate final pay: departure holiday pay + pro-rata year-end bonus
steps.description: Calculate the final pay including departure holiday pay (vertrekvakantiegeld) and, where the company CLA grants it, the pro-rata year-end bonus (eindejaarspremie).

steps.name: Return company car & stop benefit-in-kind
steps.description: Organise the return of the company car and fuel card, and stop the benefit-in-kind (VAA/BIK) in payroll from the correct month.

steps.name: Notify group insurance (pension) provider
steps.description: Notify the group insurance (supplementary pension) provider of the exit so the insurer can issue the exit statement and options to the employee.

steps.name: Dimona OUT + social documents (C4, holiday certificate)
steps.description: Declare Dimona OUT to the social security and issue the C4 and the holiday certificate (vakantieattest) to the employee.

steps.name: Capture the senior's tacit knowledge before exit (handover)
steps.description: Capture the undocumented know-how of the departing senior (store network, supplier contacts, peak-season routines) and transfer it to the successor before the last working day.
